profiles.scope: Reviewed main pool printed card traits and base/first-upgrade rules; three saved-card rules; potion printed rules/usage/targets; relic general rules/rarity. Runtime simulation, all availability conditions, other systems and beta are not certified. Initial monster HP before scaling and modifiers is reviewed separately from attack patterns. Declared possible-monster rosters and room types are reviewed for main encounters; counts, generation probabilities and encounter adjustments are not simulated. Main timeline requirements, reward lists, score-bar sequence and placeholder classification are reviewed; saved progression is displayed rather than simulated. Separately reviewed event option effects and local eligibility checks are included only for listed events. All 65 main event/Ancient option summaries and normal act-pool placement are reviewed; cross-entity hooks and event simulations remain bounded. Enchantment titles, rules and eligibility are reviewed; per-copy amounts and status reset timing are not. Move sets and turn patterns are reviewed for all 107 monsters with reviewed HP; power effects, summon slot rules and forced-state triggers are not.

EVENT.ABYSSAL_BATHS.description: Choose healing or repeatable Max HP gains with an increasing damage cost.

choices.outcome: Heal 10 HP and leave.
Gain 2 Max HP, then take 3 unblockable damage. You may stay in the baths.
Gain another 2 Max HP, then take damage. The first Linger deals 4 damage; each subsequent use costs 1 more damage.
Leave without any further effect.

EVENT.ABYSSAL_BATHS.notes: Linger is available after Immerse. Its damage keeps increasing with repeated use; remaining in the baths can kill you.

EVENT.AMALGAMATOR.description: Trade two eligible basic cards for one Ultimate card.

choices.outcome: Remove 2 chosen removable Basic cards with the Strike tag; add Ultimate Strike.
Remove 2 chosen removable Basic cards with the Defend tag; add Ultimate Defend.

EVENT.AMALGAMATOR.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 2 removable Basic Strikes and 2 removable Basic Defends.

EVENT.AROMA_OF_CHAOS.description: Change one card in your deck.

choices.outcome: Choose an eligible card to transform into a random card.
Choose an eligible card to upgrade.

EVENT.BATTLEWORN_DUMMY.description: Choose one training dummy and defeat it within its three-turn time limit.

choices.outcome: Fight the 75 base HP dummy. Defeating it in time offers a random unlocked character/shared Potion.
Fight the 150 base HP dummy. Defeating it in time upgrades up to 2 random upgradeable cards in your deck.
Fight the 300 base HP dummy. Defeating it in time grants the next random relic from your reward pool.

EVENT.BATTLEWORN_DUMMY.notes: Only the chosen dummy appears. HP scales in multiplayer. If the time limit expires, the dummy leaves and grants no reward.

EVENT.BRAIN_LEECH.description: Choose a larger character-card selection or pay HP for a Colorless reward.

choices.outcome: Choose 1 of 5 generated cards from your character pool to add to your deck; this selection cannot be canceled.
Take 5 unblockable damage, then receive one Colorless card reward with 3 choices.

EVENT.BUGSLAYER.description: Choose one of two special cards to add to your deck.

choices.outcome: Add Exterminate to your deck.
Add Squash to your deck.

EVENT.BUGSLAYER.notes: These options grant a card directly; they do not start a combat.

EVENT.BYRDONIS_NEST.description: Use the egg for Max HP or take it as a card.

choices.outcome: Gain 7 Max HP.
Add Byrdonis Egg to your deck.

EVENT.BYRDONIS_NEST.availability_note: Eligible only when no player already has an event-pet relic or Byrdonis Egg.

EVENT.TRASH_HEAP.description: Choose a relic with an HP cost, or Gold with a random legacy card.

choices.outcome: Take 8 unblockable damage. Receive one random relic from Darkstone Periapt, Dream Catcher, Hand Drill, Maw Bank and The Boot.
Gain 100 Gold and add one random card from Caltrops, Clash, Distraction, Dual Wield, Entrench, Hello World, Outmaneuver, Rebound, Rip and Tear and Stack.

EVENT.TRASH_HEAP.availability_note: Its native entry check requires every player to have more than 5 current HP. Dive In still costs 8 damage and can be lethal. Requires the Trash Heap timeline unlock.

EVENT.COLORFUL_PHILOSOPHERS.description: Choose an offered character color and receive three card rewards from that pool.

choices.outcome: Receive one Common, one Uncommon and one Rare card reward, each with 3 choices, from the chosen other character pool.

EVENT.COLORFUL_PHILOSOPHERS.notes: Up to 3 other unlocked character colors are offered. Your own character pool is excluded.
EVENT.COLORFUL_PHILOSOPHERS.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has more than one unlocked character card pool. Requires the Colorful Philosophers timeline unlock.

EVENT.COLOSSAL_FLOWER.description: Take the current prize or accept escalating damage to reach a deeper prize.

choices.outcome: Gain 35 Gold without taking damage.
Take 5 unblockable damage in total; gain 75 Gold.
Take 11 unblockable damage in total; gain 135 Gold.
After reaching the final choice, take another 7 unblockable damage: 18 total damage for the Pollinous Core relic.

EVENT.COLOSSAL_FLOWER.notes: Gold prizes are alternatives, not cumulative rewards. Taking Pollinous Core does not also grant the Gold prize.
EVENT.COLOSSAL_FLOWER.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 19 current HP.

EVENT.CRYSTAL_SPHERE.description: Pay Gold or accept Debt to play a reward-reveal minigame.

choices.outcome: Pay the displayed randomized cost of 51–99 Gold and receive 3 divinations.
Add Debt to your deck and receive 6 divinations.

EVENT.CRYSTAL_SPHERE.notes: Divinations uncover cells on the reward board, not future map encounters. Rewards depend on which items you fully uncover; the offered costs do not guarantee every board reward.
EVENT.CRYSTAL_SPHERE.availability_note: Available after Act 1 when every player has at least 100 Gold.

EVENT.DENSE_VEGETATION.description: Take damage for Gold, or rest before fighting Wrigglers.

choices.outcome: Take 8 unblockable damage and gain 61–99 Gold.
Receive your rest-site healing effect, normally 30% of Max HP before modifiers, then enter the Wriggler encounter.

EVENT.DENSE_VEGETATION.notes: Trudge On does not remove a card. Rest-site modifiers can change healing and other rest effects.
EVENT.DENSE_VEGETATION.availability_note: In multiplayer, every player must have more than 8 current HP. The solo entry check has no HP restriction.

EVENT.DOLL_ROOM.description: Receive a doll relic, with an optional HP cost for more choice.

choices.outcome: Receive one random doll relic without an HP cost.
Take 5 unblockable damage and choose one of 2 randomly offered doll relics.
Take 15 unblockable damage and choose one of all 3 doll relics.

EVENT.DOLL_ROOM.notes: The doll relics are Daughter of the Wind, Mr. Struggles and Bing Bong.

EVENT.DOORS_OF_LIGHT_AND_DARK.description: Choose random upgrades or a targeted removal.

choices.outcome: Upgrade up to 2 random upgradeable cards in your deck.
Choose one eligible card to remove from your deck.

EVENT.DROWNING_BEACON.description: Choose a potion or trade Max HP for a relic.

choices.outcome: Receive a Glowwater Potion reward.
Lose 13 Max HP and obtain Fresnel Lens.

EVENT.DROWNING_BEACON.notes: Climb reduces maximum health; it is not ordinary damage.

EVENT.ENDLESS_CONVEYOR.description: Buy the current dish repeatedly, or take a free random upgrade and leave.

choices.outcome: Upgrade one random upgradeable card for free and leave. This option is available before buying a dish.
Pay 40 Gold to gain 4 Max HP.
Pay 40 Gold to upgrade one random upgradeable card.
Pay 40 Gold to choose an eligible card to transform.
Pay 40 Gold to add one random Colorless card.
Pay 40 Gold to receive a random unlocked character/shared Potion reward.
Pay 40 Gold to heal 10 HP.
Gain 75 Gold; this dish does not charge the normal price.
Pay 40 Gold to add Feeding Frenzy.
After buying a dish, leave without buying another.

EVENT.ENDLESS_CONVEYOR.notes: Only the currently displayed dish is purchasable. Every fifth offered dish is Seapunk Salad. Other rolls exclude the previous dish; Clam Roll needs missing HP and Suspicious Condiment needs an open potion slot. Golden Fysh cannot be the first offer. The purchase button still requires at least 40 Gold even for Golden Fysh.
EVENT.ENDLESS_CONVEYOR.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 120 Gold.

EVENT.FIELD_OF_MAN_SIZED_HOLES.description: Choose removals with a Curse, or a card enchantment.

choices.outcome: Remove 2 chosen eligible cards, then add Normality to your deck.
Enchant one eligible card with Perfect Fit.

EVENT.FIELD_OF_MAN_SIZED_HOLES.notes: Perfect Fit places the card at the top when it is reshuffled during combat; it does not change the initial shuffle. Neither option grants Gold.
EVENT.FIELD_OF_MAN_SIZED_HOLES.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has a card that can receive Perfect Fit.

EVENT.GRAVE_OF_THE_FORGOTTEN.description: Choose a relic or remove Exhaust from a card at the cost of a Curse.

choices.outcome: Add Decay to your deck, then enchant an eligible card with Soul's Power, removing its Exhaust keyword.
Obtain Forgotten Soul.

EVENT.GRAVE_OF_THE_FORGOTTEN.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has a card that can receive Soul's Power. Confront requires an eligible card with Exhaust.

EVENT.HUNGRY_FOR_MUSHROOMS.description: Choose one of two mushroom relics.

choices.outcome: Obtain Big Mushroom: gain 20 Max HP on pickup, but draw 2 fewer cards on the first turn of each combat.
Obtain Fragrant Mushroom: take 15 unblockable damage and upgrade up to 2 random upgradeable cards on pickup.

EVENT.INFESTED_AUTOMATON.description: Receive a random card matching one of two filters.

choices.outcome: Add one random Power generated from your character pool.
Add one random card from your character pool with a base Energy cost of 0; X-cost cards are excluded.

EVENT.INFESTED_AUTOMATON.notes: Touch Core filters Energy cost, not Star cost. Neither option offers a choice among several cards.

EVENT.LOST_WISP.description: Choose a cursed relic or a Gold reward.

choices.outcome: Add Decay to your deck and obtain Lost Wisp.
Gain 45–75 Gold.

EVENT.LUMINOUS_CHOIR.description: Choose removals with a Curse or buy a relic.

choices.outcome: Remove 2 chosen eligible cards, then add Spore Mind to your deck.
Pay the displayed randomized price of 100–149 Gold and obtain the next relic from your reward pool.

EVENT.LUMINOUS_CHOIR.notes: Offer Tribute is locked if you cannot pay its displayed price.
EVENT.LUMINOUS_CHOIR.availability_note: The entry check requires sufficient Gold and an available relic in every player's reward pool.

EVENT.MORPHIC_GROVE.description: Trade all your Gold for two transforms, or gain Max HP.

choices.outcome: Lose all your Gold, then choose 2 eligible cards to transform.
Gain 5 Max HP.

EVENT.MORPHIC_GROVE.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 100 Gold and at least 2 transformable cards.

EVENT.POTION_COURIER.description: Choose three Foul Potions or one random Uncommon Potion.

choices.outcome: Receive 3 Foul Potion rewards.
Receive one random Uncommon Potion from your unlocked character/shared pools.

EVENT.RANWID_THE_ELDER.description: Trade the displayed Potion, Gold, or the displayed relic for new relics.

choices.outcome: Discard the randomly selected Potion shown by the event; obtain one relic from your reward pool.
Pay 100 Gold and obtain one relic from your reward pool.
Remove the randomly selected tradable relic shown by the event; obtain 2 relics from your reward pool.

EVENT.RANWID_THE_ELDER.notes: The Potion and relic offered for sacrifice are selected by the event, not freely chosen from your inventory.
EVENT.RANWID_THE_ELDER.availability_note: Available after Act 1 when every player has a Potion, at least 100 Gold and at least one tradable relic.

EVENT.REFLECTIONS.description: Redistribute upgrades or duplicate your deck at the cost of a Curse.

choices.outcome: Downgrade up to 2 random upgraded cards, then upgrade up to 4 random eligible cards.
Add a copy of each card currently in your deck, then add Bad Luck.

EVENT.REFLECTIONS.notes: The upgrade selection happens after the downgrades, so a downgraded card can be upgraded again. Shatter duplicates the original deck once.

EVENT.RELIC_TRADER.description: Choose one of the displayed relic-for-relic trades.

choices.outcome: Remove the specified owned relic and obtain its paired new relic. The event ends after one trade.
If no eligible owned relic remains, proceed without trading.

EVENT.RELIC_TRADER.notes: Up to 3 randomly selected tradable owned relics are paired with new relics from your reward pool. These are specific pairs, not a free choice of any replacement.
EVENT.RELIC_TRADER.availability_note: Available after Act 1 when every player has at least 5 tradable relics.

EVENT.ROOM_FULL_OF_CHEESE.description: Choose Common cards or pay HP for Chosen Cheese.

choices.outcome: Choose 2 cards from 8 generated Common cards from your character pool.
Take 14 unblockable damage and obtain Chosen Cheese.

EVENT.SAPPHIRE_SEED.description: Choose healing with an upgrade or a card enchantment.

choices.outcome: Heal 9 HP, then choose an eligible card to upgrade.
Enchant one eligible card with Sown 1.

EVENT.SELF_HELP_BOOK.description: Choose an enchantment for a matching eligible card type.

choices.outcome: Enchant one eligible Attack with Sharp 2.
Enchant one eligible Skill with Nimble 2.
Enchant one eligible Power with Swift 2.

choices.option: Skip if no card is eligible
choices.outcome: Leave without an effect when none of the three options has an eligible card.

EVENT.SELF_HELP_BOOK.notes: Each enchantment option is locked unless you have a card meeting both its type restriction and enchantment eligibility.

EVENT.SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.description: Accept removal of the displayed card, or pay escalating HP to change the offer.

choices.outcome: Remove the displayed card from your deck and leave.
Take 3 unblockable damage on the first use, then 4, 5 and so on. Each use changes the proposed card removal.

EVENT.SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.notes: The initial offer prefers a removable non-Basic card. Later offers try to avoid the previous card type and skipped copies, falling back to removable cards when necessary. There is no safe paid exit: holding on keeps increasing the cost.
EVENT.SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.availability_note: Available after total floor 6 when every player has at least one removable card.

EVENT.SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.description: Choose a Basic-card replay enchantment or healing.

choices.outcome: Enchant one eligible Basic Strike or Defend with Spiral, adding one replay when played.
Heal 33% of Max HP, rounded down before healing modifiers.

EVENT.SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has a card that can receive Spiral.

EVENT.SPIRIT_GRAFTER.description: Choose healing with Metamorphosis or pay HP for an upgrade.

choices.outcome: Heal 25 HP and add Metamorphosis to your deck.
Choose an eligible card to upgrade, then take 10 unblockable damage.

EVENT.STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.description: Trade the displayed Potion for Max HP, or pay HP to enchant a card.

choices.outcome: Discard the randomly selected Potion shown by the event and gain 10 Max HP.
Take 6 unblockable damage, then enchant one eligible card with Vigorous 8.

EVENT.STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.notes: Lift discards the Potion without activating its ordinary effect. Push is locked if no card can receive Vigorous.
EVENT.STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.availability_note: Available in Act 2 when every player has at least one Potion.

EVENT.SUNKEN_STATUE.description: Choose a relic or dive for Gold at an HP cost.

choices.outcome: Obtain Sword of Stone.
Gain 101–121 Gold, then take 7 unblockable damage.

EVENT.SUNKEN_TREASURY.description: Choose a smaller Gold reward or a larger reward with Greed.

choices.outcome: Gain 52–67 Gold.
Gain 303–363 Gold and add Greed to your deck.

EVENT.SYMBIOTE.description: Choose a card enchantment or a transform.

choices.outcome: Enchant one eligible card with Corrupted 1.
Choose one eligible card to transform.

EVENT.SYMBIOTE.notes: Approach is locked if no card can receive Corrupted.

EVENT.TABLET_OF_TRUTH.description: Heal immediately or repeatedly sacrifice Max HP for upgrades.

choices.outcome: Heal 20 HP and leave. Available before deciphering.
Lose 3, then 6, then 12, then 24 Max HP on successive uses. Each use upgrades one random upgradeable card if available.
Reduce your Max HP to 1, then upgrade all remaining upgradeable cards. The event ends.
After a non-final decipher, leave without another sacrifice or upgrade.

EVENT.TABLET_OF_TRUTH.notes: The costs are permanent Max HP losses. A non-final sacrifice that meets or exceeds your current Max HP kills you; the displayed warning is not a protective limit.

EVENT.TEA_MASTER.description: Buy one of two teas or receive Tea of Discourtesy.

choices.outcome: Pay 50 Gold and obtain Bone Tea.
Pay 150 Gold and obtain Ember Tea.
Obtain Tea of Discourtesy without a Gold cost.

EVENT.TEA_MASTER.notes: Paid options are locked if you cannot afford them.
EVENT.TEA_MASTER.availability_note: Available before Act 3 when every player has at least 150 Gold.

EVENT.THE_FUTURE_OF_POTIONS.description: Trade an offered Potion for an upgraded card reward.

choices.outcome: Discard that Potion, then receive a reward with 3 upgraded cards matching the displayed rarity and card type from your character pool.

EVENT.THE_FUTURE_OF_POTIONS.notes: The event offers at most the first 3 held Potions. Each receives a random Attack, Skill or Power type; Common and Token Potions exclude Powers. Rare/Event Potions yield Rare cards, Uncommon yields Uncommon, and Common/Token yields Common.
EVENT.THE_FUTURE_OF_POTIONS.availability_note: Eligible only when every player holds at least 2 Potions.

EVENT.THE_LANTERN_KEY.description: Return the key for Gold or fight to keep it.

choices.outcome: Gain 100 Gold.
Fight the Mysterious Knight. Victory offers a Lantern Key card to each player.

EVENT.THE_LEGENDS_WERE_TRUE.description: Take Spoils Map or pay HP for a Potion.

choices.outcome: Add Spoils Map to your deck.
Take 8 unblockable damage and receive one random unlocked character/shared Potion reward.

EVENT.THE_LEGENDS_WERE_TRUE.availability_note: Available in Act 1 when every player has a nonempty deck and at least 10 current HP.

EVENT.THIS_OR_THAT.description: Choose Gold with an HP cost or a relic with a Curse.

choices.outcome: Take 6 unblockable damage, then gain 41–68 Gold.
Obtain the next relic from your reward pool and add Clumsy to your deck.

EVENT.WAR_HISTORIAN_REPY.description: Use Lantern Key to free Repy or open the chest.

choices.outcome: Consume the required Lantern Key cards, free Repy and obtain History Course.
Consume the required Lantern Key cards and receive 2 Potion rewards and 2 relic rewards.

EVENT.WAR_HISTORIAN_REPY.notes: Solo consumes one key for the initial choice. If another key remains, the other reward is then offered and consumes the remaining keys. Multiplayer consumes all held keys for the initial choice and does not offer the extra reward.
EVENT.WAR_HISTORIAN_REPY.availability_note: Not a random event: Lantern Key replaces the next event in Act 3 with this encounter.

EVENT.WATERLOGGED_SCRIPTORIUM.description: Gain Max HP or buy Retain enchantments.

choices.outcome: Gain 6 Max HP.
Pay 55 Gold and enchant one eligible card with Steady, adding Retain.
Pay 99 Gold and enchant 2 eligible cards with Steady, adding Retain.

EVENT.WATERLOGGED_SCRIPTORIUM.notes: Paid options are locked when their Gold cost is unaffordable.
EVENT.WATERLOGGED_SCRIPTORIUM.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 55 Gold.

EVENT.WELLSPRING.description: Choose a Potion or replace a card with Guilty.

choices.outcome: Receive one random unlocked character/shared Potion reward.
Remove one chosen eligible card, then add Guilty to your deck.

EVENT.WHISPERING_HOLLOW.description: Buy Potion rewards or pay HP for a transform.

choices.outcome: Pay the displayed cost of 26–44 Gold and receive 2 Potion rewards.
Choose one eligible card to transform, then take 9 unblockable damage.

EVENT.WHISPERING_HOLLOW.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 44 Gold.

EVENT.WOOD_CARVINGS.description: Transform a Basic card or add a cost-randomizing enchantment.

choices.outcome: Choose an eligible transformable Basic card and turn it into Peck.
Enchant one eligible card with Slither.
Choose an eligible transformable Basic card and turn it into Toric Toughness.

EVENT.WOOD_CARVINGS.notes: Snake is locked if no card can receive Slither. The transform options require a transformable Basic card.
EVENT.WOOD_CARVINGS.availability_note: The entry check requires every player to have at least one removable Basic card.

EVENT.ZEN_WEAVER.description: Buy Enlightenment cards or targeted card removals.

choices.outcome: Pay 50 Gold and add 2 Enlightenment cards to your deck.
Remove one chosen eligible card and pay 125 Gold.
Remove 2 chosen eligible cards and pay 250 Gold.

EVENT.ZEN_WEAVER.notes: The removal options are locked when their Gold cost is unaffordable.
EVENT.ZEN_WEAVER.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 125 Gold.

EVENT.TINKER_TIME.description: Build a customized Mad Science card from two successive choices.

choices.outcome: Choose one of 2 randomly offered types from Attack, Skill and Power.
Choose one of 2 randomly offered effects from the 3 belonging to that card type. Add the resulting Mad Science card to your deck.

EVENT.TINKER_TIME.notes: Attack offers Sapping, Violence or Choking; Skill offers Energized, Wisdom or Chaos; Power offers Expertise, Curious or Improvement. Only 2 choices appear at each stage. The saved card retains the selected type and effect; Spirescope uses those properties when available.

EVENT.TRIAL.description: Accept a randomly selected trial, then choose its verdict.

choices.outcome: Enter one of three randomly selected cases: Merchant, Noble or Nondescript.
Add Regret and obtain 2 relics from your reward pool.
Add Shame, then choose up to 2 eligible cards to upgrade.
Heal 10 HP.
Add Regret and gain 300 Gold.
Add Doubt and receive 2 character-card rewards with 3 choices each.
Add Doubt, then choose 2 eligible cards to transform.
The event asks again: accept a trial or double down.
Open the Abandon Run confirmation dialog.

EVENT.TRIAL.notes: Only the selected case supplies verdict choices. Reject does not provide a harmless exit, and Double Down asks to abandon the run rather than granting a reward.

EVENT.UNREST_SITE.description: Choose full healing with a Curse or trade Max HP for a relic.

choices.outcome: Heal your missing HP and add Poor Sleep to your deck.
Lose 8 Max HP and obtain the next relic from your reward pool.

EVENT.UNREST_SITE.availability_note: Eligible only when every player is at or below 70% of their Max HP.

EVENT.FAKE_MERCHANT.description: Shop for fake relics, or provoke the merchant with Foul Potion.

choices.outcome: Pay its displayed shop price and obtain that fake relic. The shop stocks 6 random relics from its 9-item pool.
Start the Fake Merchant encounter. Victory offers Fake Merchant's Rug and the relics still stocked in the shop.
Return to the map without buying anything else.

EVENT.FAKE_MERCHANT.notes: The stock consists of fake versions of Anchor, Blood Vial, Happy Flower, Lee's Waffle, Mango, Orichalcum, Snecko Eye, Strike Dummy and Venerable Tea Set. Each has a 50-Gold base price, with shop price variation and modifiers. The rug is a combat reward and cannot be purchased.
EVENT.FAKE_MERCHANT.availability_note: Solo only, after Act 1. You must have at least 100 Gold or hold Foul Potion.

EVENT.JUNGLE_MAZE_ADVENTURE.description: Choose a dangerous solo expedition or a smaller reward with help.

choices.outcome: Take 18 unblockable damage and gain the displayed random Gold reward (150 before a variation of up to 15 in either direction).
Gain the displayed random Gold reward (50 before a variation of up to 15 in either direction), with no HP cost.

EVENT.JUNGLE_MAZE_ADVENTURE.notes: The two Gold amounts are rolled separately. The expedition animation does not start a combat.

EVENT.PUNCH_OFF.description: Take a Curse for a relic, or fight for additional rewards.

choices.outcome: Add Injury to your deck and receive 1 relic reward.

choices.option: I Can Take Them, then Fight
choices.outcome: Start the Punch Off encounter. Victory offers each player 1 relic and 1 potion.

EVENT.PUNCH_OFF.notes: The punches shown before your choice are an animation; they do not reduce the enemies' HP.

EVENT.ROUND_TEA_PARTY.description: Choose healing with Royal Poison or take damage for a relic.

choices.outcome: Obtain Royal Poison and heal your missing HP.
Take 11 unblockable damage and obtain the next relic from your reward pool.

EVENT.ROUND_TEA_PARTY.notes: Royal Poison deals 4 unblockable damage at the start of your first turn in each combat. Picking a fight here does not start a combat encounter.
EVENT.ROUND_TEA_PARTY.availability_note: Eligible only when every player has at least 12 current HP.

EVENT.WELCOME_TO_WONGOS.description: Buy one item and earn Wongo Points, or leave at the cost of an upgrade.

choices.outcome: Pay 100 Gold for a random shop-eligible Common relic and earn 32 Wongo Points.
Pay 200 Gold for the displayed shop-eligible Rare relic and earn 16 Wongo Points.
Pay 300 Gold for Wongo's Mystery Ticket and earn 8 Wongo Points. The ticket offers 3 relic rewards after 5 completed combats, once.
Downgrade one random upgraded card in your deck, if you have any.

EVENT.WELCOME_TO_WONGOS.notes: Purchases require enough Gold. Crossing a 2,000-point boundary in accumulated Wongo Points grants the Wongo Customer Appreciation Badge relic. These points and this relic are separate from the end-of-run score and score badges.
EVENT.WELCOME_TO_WONGOS.availability_note: Act 2 only; every player must have at least 100 Gold.

EVENT.DARV.description: Choose one of three Ancient relic offers, with act-dependent candidates.

choices.outcome: Obtain the selected relic. Possible candidates are Astrolabe, Black Star, Calling Bell, Empty Cage, Pandora's Box, Runic Pyramid and Snecko Eye, plus the conditional offers below.
One candidate is randomly chosen from Ectoplasm and Sozu before the final offers are selected.
One candidate is randomly chosen from Philosopher's Stone and Velvet Choker before the final offers are selected.
May replace one of the three offers. It adds the displayed upgraded Ancient card from your character's unlocked pool, excluding Archaic Tooth's transformed starter cards.

EVENT.DARV.notes: On entry, heal your missing HP; at Ascension 2 or higher, the base healing is 80% of missing HP. Healing modifiers still apply. Choose only one of the displayed relic offers, applying that relic's effects. Each eligible relic group supplies one candidate, then the candidates are shuffled. Half the time, the offers are Dusty Tome plus 2 shuffled candidates; otherwise they are 3 shuffled candidates. Pandora's Box is excluded when a run modifier clears the starting deck.
EVENT.DARV.availability_note: Requires Darv's timeline unlock. May enter the Ancient pool for Act 2 or Act 3; an appearance is not guaranteed.

EVENT.NEOW.description: Without run modifiers, choose one starting relic from two positive-pool offers and one tradeoff-pool offer.

choices.outcome: Obtain the displayed relic. The base pool is Arcane Scroll, Booming Conch, Fishing Rod, Golden Pearl, Kaleidoscope, Lead Paperweight, Lost Coffer, Massive Scroll, Neow's Torment, New Leaf, Phial Holster, Precise Scissors, Scroll Boxes and Winged Boots.
Obtain the displayed relic from Cursed Pearl, Hefty Tablet, Large Capsule, Leafy Poultice, Neow's Bones, Precarious Shears, Silken Tress or Silver Crucible. Apply its stated benefits and costs.
The normal relic offers are replaced by modifier-specific opening actions, shown one at a time. A modifier run can have no opening action.

EVENT.NEOW.notes: The tradeoff offer is selected first. Cursed Pearl excludes Golden Pearl; Hefty Tablet excludes Arcane Scroll; Leafy Poultice excludes New Leaf; Precarious Shears excludes Precise Scissors. Unless Large Capsule is selected, either Lava Rock or Small Capsule joins the positive pool. Either Nutritious Oyster or Stone Humidifier, and either Neow's Talisman or Pomander, also join it before the 2 positive offers are drawn. Relic eligibility is checked: Massive Scroll is multiplayer only; Winged Boots and Silver Crucible are solo only; Kaleidoscope requires all character card pools unlocked; Scroll Boxes requires at least 4 unlocked Common and 2 unlocked Uncommon cards in its pool. Neow starts you at full Max HP, or 80% of Max HP at Ascension 2+, before healing modifiers. Choose one normal offer; the pool names do not mean every tradeoff necessarily adds a Curse.

EVENT.NONUPEIPE.description: Choose one of three randomly drawn relic offers.

choices.outcome: Obtain one offered relic from Blessed Antler, Brilliant Scarf, Delicate Frond, Diamond Diadem, Fur Coat, Glitter, Jewelry Box, Looming Fruit and Signet Ring.
Joins the pool only when at least 4 cards in your deck can receive Swift.

EVENT.NONUPEIPE.notes: On entry, heal your missing HP; at Ascension 2 or higher, the base healing is 80% of missing HP. Healing modifiers still apply. Choose only one of the displayed relic offers, applying that relic's effects. The eligible pool is shuffled and 3 different offers are shown. Enchantment eligibility includes existing enchantments and whether the card can be played.

EVENT.OROBAS.description: Choose one relic from three separately generated offer groups.

choices.outcome: One of Electric Shrymp, Glass Eye, Sand Castle, or a fourth candidate: Prismatic Gem or Sea Glass.
One of Alchemical Coffer, Driftwood or Radiant Pearl.
Touch of Orobas if you have a Starter relic, or Archaic Tooth if you have an eligible starter card. If both are eligible, one is randomly offered; if neither is eligible, this offer is locked.

EVENT.OROBAS.notes: On entry, heal your missing HP; at Ascension 2 or higher, the base healing is 80% of missing HP. Healing modifiers still apply. Choose only one of the displayed relic offers, applying that relic's effects. The fourth candidate in the first group is Prismatic Gem about one-third of the time, otherwise Sea Glass; only then is one of the four first-group candidates drawn. Sea Glass uses a random other unlocked character, falling back to your character if needed. Archaic Tooth selects the first eligible card in deck order: Bash becomes Break, Neutralize becomes Suppress, Unleash becomes Protector, Falling Star becomes Meteor Shower, and Dualcast becomes Quadcast. Its upgrade and enchantment are carried across.

EVENT.PAEL.description: Choose one relic from three separately generated offer groups.

choices.outcome: One of Pael's Flesh, Pael's Horn or Pael's Tears.
Pael's Wing or Pael's Growth; Pael's Claw also qualifies with at least 3 Goopy-eligible cards, and Pael's Tooth qualifies with at least 5 removable cards.
Pael's Eye or Pael's Blood; Pael's Legion also qualifies when you have no event pet.

EVENT.PAEL.notes: On entry, heal your missing HP; at Ascension 2 or higher, the base healing is 80% of missing HP. Healing modifiers still apply. Choose only one of the displayed relic offers, applying that relic's effects. In the second group, Wing and each eligible Claw/Tooth candidate have twice the selection weight of Growth. Goopy requires an eligible Defend-tagged card; already enchanted or unplayable cards can fail the eligibility check.

EVENT.TANX.description: Choose one of three randomly drawn relic offers.

choices.outcome: Obtain one offered relic from Claws, Crossbow, Iron Club, Meat Cleaver, Sai, Spiked Gauntlets, Tanx's Whistle, Throwing Axe and War Hammer.
Joins the pool only when at least 3 cards in your deck can receive Instinct.

EVENT.TANX.notes: On entry, heal your missing HP; at Ascension 2 or higher, the base healing is 80% of missing HP. Healing modifiers still apply. Choose only one of the displayed relic offers, applying that relic's effects. The eligible pool is shuffled and 3 different offers are shown. Instinct requires eligible Attack cards, including checks for existing enchantments and unplayable cards.

EVENT.TEZCATARA.description: Choose one relic from three separately generated offer groups.

choices.outcome: Very Hot Cocoa or Yummy Cookie; Nutritious Soup also qualifies when your deck contains at least one Basic-rarity Strike-tagged card.
One of Biiig Hug, Storybook or Toasty Mittens.
One of Golden Compass, Pumpkin Candle, Toy Box or Seal of Gold.

EVENT.TEZCATARA.notes: On entry, heal your missing HP; at Ascension 2 or higher, the base healing is 80% of missing HP. Healing modifiers still apply. Choose only one of the displayed relic offers, applying that relic's effects.

EVENT.VAKUU.description: Choose one relic from three separately generated offer groups.

choices.outcome: One of Blood-Soaked Rose, Whispering Earring or Fiddle.
One of Preserved Fog, Sere Talon or Distinguished Cape. Taking the cape loses 9 Max HP and adds 3 Apparitions.
One of Choices Paradox, Music Box, Lord's Parasol or Jeweled Mask.

EVENT.VAKUU.notes: On entry, heal your missing HP; at Ascension 2 or higher, the base healing is 80% of missing HP. Healing modifiers still apply. Choose only one of the displayed relic offers, applying that relic's effects. Each group is shuffled independently and supplies one offer.

ENCHANTMENT.ADROIT.title: Adroit
ENCHANTMENT.ADROIT.eligibility: No card-type restriction beyond the base enchantment rules.
ENCHANTMENT.ADROIT.mechanics_note: On play the owner gains {Amount} Block; the amount is saved per copy.

ENCHANTMENT.CLONE.title: Clone
ENCHANTMENT.CLONE.description: This card can be duplicated at Rest Sites.
ENCHANTMENT.CLONE.eligibility: No card-type restriction beyond the base enchantment rules.
ENCHANTMENT.CLONE.mechanics_note: No combat behaviour in the native enchantment model; the Rest Site duplication offer is implemented elsewhere and was not reviewed.

ENCHANTMENT.CORRUPTED.title: Corrupted
ENCHANTMENT.CORRUPTED.description: Deal 50% more damage, but lose 2 HP.
ENCHANTMENT.CORRUPTED.mechanics_note: Powered attack damage x1.5; on play the owner takes 2 unblockable, unpowered damage.

ENCHANTMENT.GLAM.title: Glam
ENCHANTMENT.GLAM.description: This card has Replay once per combat.
ENCHANTMENT.GLAM.eligibility: No card-type restriction beyond the base enchantment rules.
ENCHANTMENT.GLAM.mechanics_note: Replay 1 until first used in a combat, then disabled for that combat.

ENCHANTMENT.GOOPY.title: Goopy
ENCHANTMENT.GOOPY.description: This card gains Exhaust. When played, permanently increase this card's Block by 1.
ENCHANTMENT.GOOPY.extra_card_text: Permanently increase this card's Block by 1.
ENCHANTMENT.GOOPY.mechanics_note: Adds Exhaust; each play permanently raises the saved amount, which adds amount minus 1 Block.

ENCHANTMENT.IMBUED.title: Imbued
ENCHANTMENT.IMBUED.description: This card is played automatically at the start of each combat.
ENCHANTMENT.IMBUED.mechanics_note: Auto-played in the owner's first turn; starts at the bottom of the draw pile.

ENCHANTMENT.INKY.title: Inky
ENCHANTMENT.INKY.description: This card deals 1 additional damage and applies 1 Weak.
ENCHANTMENT.INKY.extra_card_text: Apply 1 Weak (to ALL enemies when the card targets all enemies).
ENCHANTMENT.INKY.eligibility: No card-type restriction beyond the base enchantment rules.
ENCHANTMENT.INKY.mechanics_note: +1 damage on powered attacks; on play applies 1 Weak to the target, or to all enemies for all-enemy cards.

ENCHANTMENT.INSTINCT.title: Instinct
ENCHANTMENT.INSTINCT.description: This card's attack damage is doubled.

ENCHANTMENT.MOMENTUM.title: Momentum
ENCHANTMENT.MOMENTUM.description: Increase this card's attack damage by {Amount} this combat when played.
ENCHANTMENT.MOMENTUM.extra_card_text: Increase this card's damage by {Amount} this combat.
ENCHANTMENT.MOMENTUM.mechanics_note: Each play adds the saved amount to this combat's extra damage, cumulatively.

ENCHANTMENT.NIMBLE.title: Nimble
ENCHANTMENT.NIMBLE.description: Increases Block gained from this card by {Amount}.

ENCHANTMENT.PERFECT_FIT.title: Perfect Fit
ENCHANTMENT.PERFECT_FIT.description: Whenever this would be shuffled into your Draw Pile, place it on the top instead.

moves.effect: 11 (12 at Ascension 9+) damage and applies 1 Frail.

MONSTER.STABBOT.pattern: Stab every turn. Built by the Fabricator.

moves.title: Thrash
moves.effect: 3 damage x3 hits (4 x3 at Ascension 9+) and gains 6 Vigor.

MONSTER.TERROR_EEL.pattern: Alternates Crash and Thrash. When its Shriek puts it into the stunned state it loses a turn, uses Terror, then resumes with Crash.

moves.title: Skull Bash
moves.effect: 14 (16 at Ascension 9+) damage and applies 1 Vulnerable.

moves.title: Respawn
moves.effect: Revives into the next form: second form HP 200 (212 at Ascension 8+) with PainfulStabsPower 1; third form HP 300 (313 at Ascension 8+) with NemesisPower 1, losing Adaptable and Painful Stabs.

moves.title: Multi-Claw
moves.effect: 10 (11 at Ascension 9+) damage x3 hits, one more hit each use.

moves.title: Lacerate
moves.effect: 10 damage x3 hits (11 x3 at Ascension 9+).

moves.title: Burning Growl
moves.effect: Adds 3 (5 at Ascension 9+) Burn to the discard pile and gains 2 (3 at Ascension 9+) Strength.

MONSTER.TEST_SUBJECT.pattern: First form alternates Bite and Skull Bash. When killed while it has AdaptablePower it respawns: the second form uses Multi Claw every turn; the third form cycles Lacerate, Big Pounce, Burning Growl.
MONSTER.TEST_SUBJECT.entry_effects: Gains AdaptablePower 1 and EnragePower 2 (3 at Ascension 9+).

moves.title: Miasma
moves.effect: Applies -2 Dexterity to the player, gains 8 Block and 2 Dexterity.

moves.title: Dread
moves.effect: 13 (15 at Ascension 9+) damage plus its current Dexterity.

MONSTER.THE_FORGOTTEN.pattern: Alternates Miasma and Dread, starting with Miasma.

moves.title: Liquify Ground
moves.effect: Applies SandpitPower 4 to each player and adds 6 Frantic Escape per player: 3 into the draw pile at random and 3 into the discard pile.

moves.title: Thrash
moves.effect: 8 damage x2 hits (9 x2 at Ascension 9+).

MONSTER.THE_INSATIABLE.pattern: Liquify Ground once; then repeats Thrash, Lunging Bite, Salivate, Thrash.

moves.title: Debilitating Smog
moves.effect: Applies -2 Strength to the player and gains 2 Strength.

moves.title: Eye Lasers
moves.effect: 4 damage x2 hits (5 x2 at Ascension 9+).

MONSTER.THE_LOST.pattern: Alternates Debilitating Smog and Eye Lasers, starting with Debilitating Smog.

moves.title: Sail
moves.effect: Gives 3 Strength to itself and every ally.

moves.title: Hardening Strike
moves.effect: 6 (7 at Ascension 9+) damage and gains 6 (7 at Ascension 9+) Block.

MONSTER.THE_OBSCURA.pattern: Illusion once; then random with equal weight among Piercing Gaze, the Strength buff and Hardening Strike, never the same move twice in a row.

moves.title: Thievery
moves.effect: 17 (19 at Ascension 9+) damage and steals one deck card from each player's draw or discard pile, preferring Uncommon, then Common, Rare or Event, then Basic or Quest, then Ancient or Imbued cards.

moves.title: Escape
moves.effect: Leaves the combat with the stolen cards.

MONSTER.THIEVING_HOPPER.pattern: Thievery, Flutter, Hat Trick, Nab, then Escape.

moves.title: Spike Spit
moves.effect: 3 damage x3 hits (4 x3 at Ascension 9+) and loses 2 Thorns.

MONSTER.TOADPOLE.pattern: The front Toadpole opens with Spiken, the others with Whirl; then it cycles Whirl, Spiken, Spike Spit.

MONSTER.TORCH_HEAD_AMALGAM.pattern: Tackle, Tackle, then repeats Beam, weaker Tackle, weaker Tackle.

moves.title: Hatch
moves.effect: Hatches: removes its powers other than Minion and re-rolls its HP to 19-22 (20-23 at Ascension 8+).

MONSTER.TOUGH_EGG.entry_effects: Gains HatchPower 1, or 2 when placed during the enemies' turn, unless it was already hatched.

moves.title: Unleash the Hounds
moves.effect: 1 damage x8 hits (1 x9 at Ascension 9+).

MONSTER.TRACKER_RUBY_RAIDER.pattern: Track once, then Hounds every turn.

moves.title: Burrow
moves.effect: Gains BurrowedPower 1 and 32 (37 at Ascension 8+) Block.

MONSTER.TUNNELER.pattern: Bite, Burrow, then Below every turn. When stunned it loses a turn and resumes from Bite.

moves.title: Unload!
moves.effect: 3 damage x5 hits (4 x5 at Ascension 9+).

moves.title: Sticky Shot
moves.effect: Adds 1 Slimed to the discard pile.

MONSTER.TWIG_SLIME_M.pattern: Starts with Sticky Shot; then random with equal weight between Pokey Pounce (at most twice in a row) and Sticky Shot (never twice in a row).

moves.title: Call for Backup
moves.effect: Adds another Two-Tailed Rat in a free slot.

MONSTER.TWO_TAILED_RAT.pattern: Random among Scratch and Disease Bite (never twice in a row) and Screech (never twice in a row, not within 3 moves of its last use). Call for Backup becomes available after a rat's first 2 moves, needs a free slot, is used at most once per rat and 3 times per encounter, and is then chosen 75% of the time. Rats in an encounter may be given different starting moves.

moves.title: Inky Lance
moves.effect: 6 damage x2 hits (7 x2 at Ascension 9+).

moves.title: Dismember
moves.effect: 26 (30 at Ascension 9+) damage and adds 3 Wound to the discard pile.

MONSTER.VANTOM.pattern: Cycles Ink Blot, Inky Lance, Dismember, Prepare.

moves.title: Grasping Vines
moves.effect: 8 (9 at Ascension 9+) damage and applies TangledPower 1.

moves.title: Swipe
moves.effect: 6 damage x2 hits (7 x2 at Ascension 9+).

MONSTER.VINE_SHAMBLER.pattern: Opens with Swipe; then cycles Swipe, Grasping Vines, Chomp.

moves.title: Stomp
moves.effect: 15 (16 at Ascension 9+) damage, applies 1 Weak and gains SteamEruptionPower 3.

moves.title: Ram
moves.effect: 10 (11 at Ascension 9+) damage and gains SteamEruptionPower 3.

moves.title: Siphon
moves.effect: Heals 10 (15 at Ascension 8+) per player and gains SteamEruptionPower 3.

moves.title: Pressure Gun
moves.effect: 20 (23 at Ascension 9+) damage, 5 more each use, and gains SteamEruptionPower 3.

moves.title: Pressure Up
moves.effect: 13 (14 at Ascension 9+) damage and gains SteamEruptionPower 3.

moves.title: About to Blow
moves.effect: Becomes unkillable and converts its SteamEruptionPower into the coming explosion.

moves.title: Explode
moves.effect: Damage equal to the converted SteamEruptionPower amount, then it dies.

MONSTER.WATERFALL_GIANT.pattern: Pressurize, then cycles Stomp, Ram, Siphon, Pressure Gun, Pressure Up. About to Blow and Explode are triggered by its SteamEruptionPower; that trigger is not reviewed.

moves.title: Wriggle
moves.effect: Adds 1 Infection to the discard pile and gains 2 Strength.

moves.title: Spawned
moves.effect: Does nothing on the turn it was spawned.

MONSTER.WRIGGLER.pattern: Wrigglers in slots 1 and 3 open with Nasty Bite, slots 2 and 4 with Wriggle; then they alternate the two. A spawned Wriggler is stunned for its first turn.

MONSTER.ZAPBOT.pattern: Zap every turn. Built by the Fabricator.
